title: KNOTZDOOM
subtitle: KNEE DEEP IN THE KNOTZ
intro:
KNOTZ STATION, DEEP SPACE RELAY OUTPOST.

Three hours ago the reactor techs opened a gateway they were told would give the station free energy forever. It gave them something else.

The last transmission from the hangar deck was screaming. Then static.

You are the only marine left on the supply shuttle. Your orders were to guard the cargo. Your orders are now to kill everything that came through that gateway, find the reactor core, and shut the gate for good.

Grab your pistol. It is going to be a long night.
outro:
The cyberdemon collapses in a shower of sparks and gore. Behind it, the gateway flickers, screams, and folds in on itself.

Knotz Station is silent again. Somewhere below, the reactor hums back to life.

You light a cigar with the still glowing barrel of your rocket launcher and start looking for the shuttle. You have a feeling this is not over.

Not even close.
tips: Doors close on their own. Keep moving.
Barrels explode. Stand well back, or use them.
Secrets are hidden behind walls that do not quite match. Press USE on anything suspicious.
Rockets hurt you too. Never fire one at point blank range.
